_doc: Generated-only replacement placement spec. Heading anchors were retained from the original reviewed placement file.

figures.alt: Painted interior door casing with a tight mitered corner
figures.caption: Check the rough opening, jamb, floor clearance, and casing plan before final trim. A clean reveal begins with a plumb frame, not with caulk at the end.

figures.alt: Aligned door hinges with even spacing along a finished door edge
figures.caption: Set hinges and shims so the slab swings freely and maintains even reveals. The hardware example shows the alignment principle; use hinges appropriate to the actual interior door.

figures.alt: Interior trim staged for a clean finished-floor and door-edge transition
figures.caption: Finish casing, baseboard, and paint after the door is adjusted and latches correctly. Trim should complete a stable opening rather than conceal a door that rubs or drifts.
